changes: Updated source/cli.py to call build_monthly_report instead of legacy compact_export, so CLI output follows the requested approved-month and per-team report contract.
Added tests/test_cli.py covering multi-team aggregation, exclusion of rejected and out-of-month rows, JSON output, and malformed-row warning on stderr.
actualcommands_outcomes: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_cli.py' -> 1 test passed.
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -> 6 tests passed.
Direct parse_money diagnostic -> Decimal('1240.13'); direct read_expenses/build_monthly_report diagnostic confirmed North total 1241.00 and grand total 1281.00.
course_correction_evidence: Stage1 incorrectly stated the fixture's approved October total was 1280.99. That was an arithmetic error: 1240.13 + 0.87 = 1241.00, then + 40.00 = 1281.00. The direct row dump and report output verify the corrected totals. The money helper remains unchanged.
acceptance_limits: Public checks and visible fixture were used; no private evaluator or oracle was accessed.
The regression test checks a malformed date warning and valid-row report behavior; it does not cover every malformed CSV shape or invalid month case.
